sentences.en: For the century before Johnson’s Dictionary was published in 1775, there had been concern about the state of the English language.
sentences.zh: 1775年出版强生字典之前的世纪,人们一直对英语的状况感到关切。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: There was no standard way of speaking or writing and no agreement as to the best way of bringing some order to the chaos of English spelling.
sentences.zh: 没有标准的语言或书面方式,也没有就使英语拼写混乱化的最佳方式达成协议。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Dr Johnson provided the solution.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊博士提供了解决方案。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: There had, of course, been dictionaries in the past, the first of these being a little book of some 120 pages, compiled by a certain Robert Cawdray, published in 1604 under the title A Table Alphabetical of hard usual English words.
sentences.zh: 当然,过去曾有过字典,其中第一个字典是一本约120页的小书,由罗伯特·考德雷编集,于1604年出版,题目为 " A表 ",用常用的英语字句按字母顺序排列。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Like the various dictionaries that came after it during the seventeenth century, Cawdray’s tended to concentrate on ‘scholarly’ words; one function of the dictionary was to enable its student to convey an impression of fine learning.
sentences.zh: Cawdray的字典往往专注于“修饰”文字; 字典的一个功能是让学生能传达良好的学习印象。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Beyond the practical need to make order out of chaos, the rise of dictionaries is associated with the rise of the English middle class, who were anxious to define and circumscribe the various worlds to conquer -lexical as well as social and commercial.
sentences.zh: 除了实际需要从混乱中秩序的秩序之外,词典的兴起与英国中产阶级的崛起有关,他们急于界定和限定各种世界以征服历史和社会及商业。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: It is highly appropriate that Dr Samuel Johnson, the very model of an eighteenth-century literary man, as famous in his own time as in ours, should have published his Dictionary at the very beginning of the heyday of the middle class.
sentences.zh: 塞缪尔·约翰逊博士是18世纪文学家的典范,他像我们一样在自己的时代出名,他非常适合在中产阶级的起步之初发表他的词典。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Johnson was a poet and critic who raised common sense to the heights of genius.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊是一位诗人和评论家他提高了常识至天才的高度。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: His approach to the problems that had worried writers throughout the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries was intensely practical.
sentences.zh: 他对17世纪末和18世纪初作家们所担心的问题的态度非常实际。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Up until his time, the task of producing a dictionary on such a large scale had seemed impossible without the establishment of an academy to make decisions about right and wrong usage.
sentences.zh: 直到他任职,如果不设立一个学院来决定对与错使用,那么如此大规模的字典编制工作似乎是不可能的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Johnson decided he did not need an academy to settle arguments about language; he would write a dictionary himself; and he would do it single-handed.
sentences.zh: Johnson决定他不需要一个学院来解决语言问题;他自己会写字典;他会单枪匹马地写字典。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Johnson signed the contract for the Dictionary with the bookseller Robert Dosley at a breakfast held at the Golden Anchor Inn near Holborn Bar on 18 June 1764.
sentences.zh: 1764年6月18日,Johnson在Holborn Bar附近的金安歇客栈举行早餐,与书商Robert Dosley签署了《词典》合同。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: He was to be paid £1,575 in instalments, and from this he took money to rent 17 Gough Square, in which he set up his ‘dictionary workshop’.
sentences.zh: 他分期获得1,575英镑,从此他拿钱租17个Gough广场,在那里他设立了他的 " 字典工作坊 " 。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: James Boswell, his biographer described the garret where Johnson worked as ‘fitted up like a counting house’ with a long desk running down the middle at which the copying clerks would work standing up.
sentences.zh: Johnson在其中工作, 写了「装扮成计数之家」, 长桌在中间, 抄录员们站立工作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Johnson himself was stationed on a rickety chair at an ‘old crazy deal table’ surrounded by a chaos of borrowed books.
sentences.zh: Johnson本人被困在一张摇摆椅上, 坐在一张“老旧的疯狂交易桌”上,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: He was also helped by six assistants, two of whom died whilst the Dictionary was still in preparation.
sentences.zh: 6名助理也协助他,其中2人在词典编写期间死亡。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The work was immense; filing about eighty large notebooks (and without a library to hand), Johnson wrote the definitions of over 40,000 words, and illustrated their many meanings with some 114,000 quotations drawn from English writing on every subject, from the Elizabethans to his own time.
sentences.zh: 这项工作是巨大的; 将大约80本大笔记本归档(没有图书馆可手), Johnson写下了40,000多个字的定义, 并用从英文书写中从伊丽莎白人到他自己的时间的每个主题的114,000条引文来说明其许多含义。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: He did not expel to achieve complete originality.
sentences.zh: 他没有为了完全原创而驱逐。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Working to a deadline, he had to draw on the best of all previous dictionaries, and to make his work one of heroic synthesis.
sentences.zh: 他必须努力争取到一个最后期限,利用所有以前字典中最好的词典,使他的工作成为英雄式的合成之一。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In fact, it was very much more.
sentences.zh: 事实上,这远远不止于此。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Unlike his predecessors, Johnson treated English very practically, as a living language, with many different shades of meaning.
sentences.zh: 与他的前任不同,约翰逊将英语作为一种有多种不同含义的活语言,实际上非常实际地对待英语。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: He adopted his definitions on the principle of English common law – according to precedent.
sentences.zh: 他根据先例采纳了他对英国普通法原则的定义。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: After its publication, his Dictionary was not seriously rivalled for over a century.
sentences.zh: 其出版后,他的词典在一百多年来没有受到严重竞争。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: After many vicissitudes the Dictionary was finally published on 15 April 1775.
sentences.zh: 经过许多变化之后,词典终于于1775年4月15日出版。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It was instantly recognised as a landmark throughout Europe.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲各地,它立即被公认为一个里程碑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: ‘This very noble work;’ wrote the leading Italian lexicographer, will be a perpetual monument of Fame to the Author, an Honour to his own Country in particular, and a general Benefit to the republic of Letters throughout Europe.
sentences.zh: 将永远成为作者的名人纪念碑, 特别是他自己的国家的荣誉, 以及整个欧洲的文艺共和国的普遍福利。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The fact that Johnson had taken on the Academies of Europe and matched them (everyone knew that forty French academics had taken forty years to produce the first French national dictionary) was cause for much English celebration.
sentences.zh: Johnson已经占领欧洲科学院并与之相匹配(每个人都知道40名法国学者花了40年时间才制作出第一本法国国家字典),这一事实是英国人庆祝很多的缘故。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Johnson had worked for nine years, ‘with little assistance of the learned, and without any patronage of the great; not in the soft obscurities of retirement, or under the shelter of academic bowers, but amidst inconvenience and distraction, in sickness and in sorrow’.
sentences.zh: Johnson工作了九年, `在知识分子的帮助下, 没有任何伟人的支持; 不是在退休的隐秘的软隐秘中,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For all its faults and eccentricities his two-volume work is a masterpiece and a landmark, in his own words, ‘setting the orthography, displaying the analogy, regulating the structures, and ascertaining the significations of English words’.
sentences.zh: 以他自己的话来说,他的两卷作品是杰作和里程碑,“决定正文、显示类比、调节结构、确定英文词的符号”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: It is the cornerstone of Standard English, an achievement which, in James Boswell’s words, ‘conferred stability on the language of his country’.
sentences.zh: 以詹姆斯·博斯韦尔的话来说,这是`该国语言的稳定 ' 。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: The Dictionary, together with his other writing, made Johnson famous and so well esteemed that his friends were able to prevail upon King George III to offer him a pension.
sentences.zh: 字典加上他的其他著作,使约翰逊出名,并受到如此尊敬的朋友们的尊敬,他能够说服乔治三世国王向他提供养恤金。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: From then on, he was to become the Johnson of folklore.
sentences.zh: 从那时起,他将成为民间传说中的强人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
